rule.title: Line 5a takes income taxes, never the penalties or interest paid with them

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this payment a penalty or interest charged with a state or local income tax, rather than the tax itself?

citation.wording: State and local income taxes paid in 2025 for a prior year, such as taxes paid with your 2024 state or local income tax return. Don't include penalties or interest.

rule.open_point: Whether a payment was made during 2025 (a January 2026 estimate is 2026's) is a-salt-5a-paid's question, on the same box; this rule answers only the penalty-or-interest half of the draft.
